q: Do all taxable citizens pay church tax?
appeared: It appeared in the June 2022 exam.

learn.text: The members of the national church pay a special church tax.

q: Is it a requirement that a Danish citizen must be a member of the national church?
appeared: It appeared in the June 2021 exam.

da.q: Er det et krav, at man som dansk statsborger skal være medlem af folkekirken?

learn.text: You do not have to be a member of the national church to be a Danish citizen.

q: How large a share of Denmark's population is a member of the national church?
appeared: It appeared in the May 2024 exam.

da.q: Hvor stor en andel af Danmarks befolkning er medlem af folkekirken?

learn.text: The majority of the Danish population, about 70 percent in 2026, is a member of the national church.
